text: NASA redesigned the oxygen tanks. No fans inside, wiring sheathed in stainless steel, and a third tank in a separate bay. An extra battery was added to the service module too. A jolted tank, the wrong voltage and one routine stir nearly killed them. Duct tape, a slingshot and thousands of engineers brought them home. Could you have built that filter, with only what was on board? Tell me in the comments.
